# Goodreads

> Goodreads is a social cataloging website for book lovers to discover, share, and discuss books across multiple genres.

Goodreads, owned by Amazon, provides a platform for readers to browse book recommendations, track reading progress, and explore content across diverse genres including fiction, nonfiction, biography, business, art, children's books, and Christian literature. The site features user authentication, reading challenges, and book discovery tools powered by community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Book recommendations
- Genre exploration
- User authentication
- Reading challenges
- New releases
- Goodreads community
- Book discovery
- Account management
- Privacy and security
- Amazon integration
- Social features
- Book giveaways
- Nonfiction
- Biography
- Children's literature

## User Authentication & Account

- [Sign In](https://www.goodreads.com/user/sign_in): User authentication and login page with social login options
- [Goodreads Sign In](https://www.goodreads.com/challenges/11680): Goodreads login and authentication page with passkey support

## Book Genres & Discovery

- [Art Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/art): Art genre page with new releases and popular book recommendations
- [Biography Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/biography): Biography genre page featuring new releases and historical biographies
- [Business Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/business): Business genre page with leadership and professional development books
- [Children's Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/children-s): Children's books genre page with picture books and young reader content
- [Christian Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/christian): Christian books genre page with fiction and living category recommendations

## Legal & Privacy

- [Terms of Use](https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms): Legal terms of use for Goodreads.com service and user accounts
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy): Privacy policy for Goodreads LLC covering user data and Amazon integration
